candidates.title: The State Rewound; the Effect Did Not
candidates.title_zh: 状态回去了，外部效果没有
candidates.researchQuestion: 当长时程智能体在失败后回退时，哪些状态必须一起恢复才能保持因果一致；对于已经逃逸出受控检查点边界的外部效果，又需要什么证据才能安全重试？
candidates.coreProposition: Aligned checkpoint restoration can recover local causal consistency, but safe end-to-end recovery requires a separate, authoritative reconciliation of every external effect before retry, compensation, acceptance, or stop.

sections.heading: The Guarantee Stops at the Controlled Boundary
External Effects Need Their Own Ledger
sections.heading_zh: 外部效果需要自己的账本

sections.heading: A Resume Gate Chooses the Next Move
sections.heading_zh: 恢复闸门怎样决定下一步

sections.heading: Idempotency and Compensation Are Not Time Machines
sections.heading_zh: 幂等与补偿不是万能橡皮擦

sections.heading: Design Rules for Effect-Capable Runtimes
sections.heading_zh: 面向运行时的设计规则

evidenceClaims.claim: AgentRewind restores model context and controlled environment state to the same checkpoint, then starts a new suffix with failure-derived memory.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，该方法把模型上下文和受控环境状态恢复到同一检查点，再携带失败经验启动新后缀。

evidenceClaims.claim: In reported GPT-5.4 comparisons, AgentRewind reaches 87.8% task success and 94.3% checklist progress versus Continue at 62.2% and 81.4%.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在 GPT-5.4 比较中，该方法的任务成功率和检查项进度为 87.8% 与 94.3%，继续执行条件为 62.2% 与 81.4%。

evidenceClaims.claim: The controlled rewind boundary is principally the workspace directory tree and does not automatically reverse remote effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，受控回退的主要边界是工作区目录树，不会自动逆转远端效果。

evidenceClaims.claim: A locally aligned rewind can be internally consistent while remaining globally inconsistent with the external world.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，局部对齐的回退可以内部一致，同时仍与外部世界不一致。

evidenceClaims.claim: Retry requires authoritative evidence that the prior effect is absent, replay-safe, idempotent, verified as compensated, or otherwise explicitly governed.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，重试需要权威证据证明旧效果不存在、可安全重放、具备幂等性、已验证补偿，或由其他明确规则治理。

candidates.title: Audit Completion Is Not Coverage Assurance
candidates.title_zh: 审计完成，不等于覆盖充分
candidates.researchQuestion: 当智能体审计达到终态时，还需要哪些独立证据，组织才能声称相关证据范围已被充分覆盖，而不只是既定搜索流程已经结束？
candidates.coreProposition: An agentic audit's terminal state proves only that a configured process ended; adequate coverage requires separate durable evidence about the searched universe, funnel losses, semantic adjudication, known-positive recovery, rejected strata, and independent review.

evidenceClaims.claim: Anthropic's earlier agentic search examined roughly 141,000 transcripts believed to potentially have internet access and surfaced three incidents.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 来源报告，早期智能体搜索检查约 14.1 万条被认为可能具备互联网访问能力的记录，并发现三起事件。

evidenceClaims.claim: A relevant omitted transcript set was later discovered, and scanning it revealed a fourth incident from January 2026.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 来源报告，后来发现一组被遗漏的相关记录，补扫后识别出第四起一月事件。

evidenceClaims.claim: The expanded two-stage search covered roughly 481 million transcripts, escalated about 9.2 million, re-identified all four known incidents, and reported no additional similar-or-worse cases.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 来源报告，扩大的两阶段搜索覆盖约 4.81 亿条记录，升级约 920 万条，重新找到全部四起已知事件，并未发现其他同等或更严重案例。

evidenceClaims.claim: A chain-of-thought-based offline monitor would have missed one incident after accepting the audited model's framing.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 来源报告，一种基于思维链的离线监控器会因接受被审计模型的叙述而漏掉一起事件。

evidenceClaims.claim: Audit execution, universe identity, funnel coverage, semantic adjudication, and organizational assurance require separate state objects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，审计执行、范围身份、漏斗覆盖、语义裁决和组织保证需要不同的状态对象。

projectRelevance.rationale: The case derives from public vendor disclosure and remains independently useful without first-party projects.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition provides the transferable audit-governance argument without a distinct community angle.
